title: Каменный мост
body: Не имеет типа квартала. В конце игры получите 2 дополнительных очка.

references.role: Edit target: 707x1121 canvas and exact lower title-ribbon geometry
Approved illustration, ability text, parchment panel and three coins

measuredGeometry.method: Read-only System.Drawing scan of title region x190..850 and y1430..1545, identifying pixels with every RGB channel <55.

limitations: Requested 707x1121 output was not honored; output is 996x1579.
Title baseline is approximately 15px below the reference and outside the allowed ±3px tolerance.
Title placement is effectively back to v1 geometry.
First input image was 707x1121 Monument, disproving the hypothesis that merely making it the first edit target guarantees that output size.
No claim of pixel-identical illustration preservation; this is an image generation result.
This was one v3 generation only; no additional attempts or production integration were performed.
